full_details: Before James was up, Cuthbert called from Holywell. His father had gone on Wednesday to a hall in the Blackfriars, stone and roofed and dry, out of the Lord Mayor's reach, and had come home walking like a man of thirty. He holds up six fingers. Cuthbert prays they are shillings. You did not hear a price. You said the neighbours like quiet, a sermon, and to be in bed by nine. He said you would be as welcome as a drum in Lent. You had not said so. You told him to tell his father the king was at two, and to wear both cloaks. At two you were Gaunt in the book the yard has. The deposition was not in the roll. The glass was not sent for. After the play James was in both cloaks, and still no sum was spoken. Home in the dark, you did not write the queen and the weaver. You wrote the weaver waking, out of order, failing in prose. You said the line to the window. The memo tried his cadence twice, and then yours. No. His. It's his. The leaf went under the others.
one_sentence: Cuthbert called about a dry hall, you played the cut king, and after dark you wrote the weaver waking and gave the line back to Kemp.
title: Heard of a dry hall, and wrote the weaver's line
